user.title: Add an RV
user.description: Create an RV profile. Vehicle details are optional. Dimensions use meters or feet, and tank capacities use liters or US gallons according to the selected measurement system.

data.name: RV profile name
data.rear_axle_count: Number of rear axle assemblies, including a tag axle

data_description.name: A unique name for this RV profile.
data_description.coach_year: The model year of the coach.
data_description.manufacturer: The chassis manufacturer, for example Prevost.
data_description.coach_builder: The company that built or converted the coach, for example Liberty.
data_description.make: The chassis make, for example H3-45.
data_description.model: The coach model or conversion name, for example Elegant Lady.
data_description.coach_identifier: An owner-assigned or manufacturer-provided coach number.
data_description.measurement_system: Used to interpret dimensions and tank capacities entered here.
data_description.storage_zone_id: Select the Home Assistant zone where the RV is normally stored.
data_description.overall_height: Meters for metric, or feet for US customary.
data_description.overall_length: Meters for metric, or feet for US customary.
data_description.overall_width: Meters for metric, or feet for US customary.
data_description.fuel_tank_capacity: Liters for metric, or US gallons for US customary.
data_description.fresh_water_tank_capacity: Liters for metric, or US gallons for US customary.
data_description.gray_water_tank_capacity: Liters for metric, or US gallons for US customary.
data_description.black_water_tank_capacity: Liters for metric, or US gallons for US customary.
data_description.rear_axle_count: Count all rear axle assemblies, including the tag axle if present. One means a single main rear axle; two means one main axle and a tag axle; three means two main axles and a tag axle. The front axle is not included.
data_description.main_rear_wheel_configuration: Whether the main rear axle has single or dual wheels.
data_description.tag_axle_wheel_configuration: Choose the tag axle wheel layout when the rear axle assembly count is greater than one.
data_description.power_entities: Select existing sensors, controls, or climate entities for the RV power system.
data_description.water_entities: Select existing sensors, controls, or climate entities for the RV water system.
data_description.chassis_entities: Select existing sensors, controls, or climate entities for the RV chassis.
data_description.climate_entities: Select existing sensors, controls, or climate entities for RV climate systems.
data_description.location_entities: Select existing sensors, controls, or climate entities for RV location.
data_description.other_entities: Select other existing entities to include with this RV.

error.name_required: Enter a name for this RV.
error.invalid_coach_year: Enter a whole model year from 1900 through next year.
error.invalid_measurement: Dimensions and tank capacities must be numbers greater than zero.
error.tag_axle_wheel_configuration_required: Choose the wheel layout for the tag axle.
error.tag_wheel_configuration_without_tag_axle: A tag axle wheel layout is only valid when the rear axle assembly count is greater than one.
error.main_rear_wheel_configuration_required: Choose the wheel layout for each main rear axle.

abort.already_configured: An RV with this name is already configured.

init.title: Map RV system entities
init.description: Choose existing entities for RV systems and each generated tire. Optionally select a binary sensor whose on state means shore power is connected. Tire readings accept sensors, number entities, input number helpers, and template sensors (which appear in Home Assistant as sensors). Readings and limits reload when you change these options.

data_description.shore_power_connected_entity: Select a binary sensor whose on state explicitly means that shore power is connected. Off is only a connection status, not a problem; an unavailable or invalid source is unavailable.

error.duplicate_entity_mapping: Each source entity can be assigned to only one RV system.
error.invalid_tire_entity_mapping: Choose a sensor, number entity, or input number helper for each tire reading.
error.invalid_shore_power_entity: Choose a binary sensor that explicitly reports whether shore power is connected.
error.duplicate_tire_entity_mapping: A tire source entity can only be assigned once.
error.incomplete_tire_pressure_threshold: Enter both low and high pressure limits, or leave both blank.
error.invalid_tire_pressure_threshold: Pressure limits must be non-negative, and the high limit must be greater than the low limit.
error.invalid_tire_temperature_threshold: The high temperature limit must be a valid non-negative number.
error.invalid_tire_battery_threshold: The low battery limit must be between 0 and 100 percent.
